newsitem.title: FRANCE: French power utility unions call walkout Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: French power utility unions call walkout Oct 17.

text.p: Unions representing French gas and electricity utility workers called on members on Tuesday to take part in a "national day of strikes" on October 17.
The appeal to join a big civil service strike set for October 17 was issued after the unions met the chairmen of Electricite de France and Gaz de France.
"The unions realise management persists in thinking that in the area of jobs, competitiveness is the only rule that counts," the CGT, CFDT, FO and CFE-CGC unions said in a joint statement.
A number of unions have called for a day of strikes and action on October 17 to fight the planned axing of 6,000 civil service jobs and demand the opening of pay negotiations.
French teachers staged a one-day strike on Monday to protest against government plans to shed several thousand jobs.
But there has been little evidence so far of dissatisfaction of the magnitude that led to the crippling four-week public sector strikes last November and December.
